comments.text: A, B, C, D, E formula leading to Malaysia in 1963 (including Singapore before separation). A = Unfederated Malay States = Kelantan, Terengganu, Kedah, Perlis, and Johor. B = Federated Malay States = Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan, and Pahang. C = Straits Settlements (before dissolution in 1946) = Penang, Malacca, and Singapore. D = Federation of Malaya (Independence 1957) = A + B + Penang + Malacca (11 states on the peninsula). E = Singapore (joined Malaysia on 16 September 1963 before leaving on 9 August 1965). Malaysia (16 September 1963, including Singapore): Malaysia = D + E + Sabah + Sarawak. (After Singapore left on 9 August 1965: Malaysia = D + Sabah + Sarawak)
